response.sql: SELECT AVG(g.avg_duration) AS avg_rental_duration, AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_rate_to_cost_ratio FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS DOUBLE) / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 AND rating IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND replacement_cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating) g;
